statistics.SHARPE_NOTE: time unit is one TRADING SESSION; annualised with sqrt(252). Computed on daily P&L, not on trade P&L.

equity.NOTE: ACCOUNT RETURN uses the declared $50,000 simulated account as denominator. There is no separate strategy return denominator; 1 ES is not a capital commitment of a stated size.

summary.SAMPLE: 16 months. Not an estimate of long-run monthly performance.

monte_carlo.method: iid bootstrap of complete trading days (preserves within-day trade clustering and the daily P&L distribution)
monte_carlo.max_losing_streak_note: see statistics.max_consecutive_losses on the real path
monte_carlo.LABEL: CONDITIONAL SIMULATION on the observed daily distribution. Not a prediction of future profitability, and not a probability of passing.
